name: PristinoBot - Notificaciones de Agroquímicos (Hardware y Manual)

parameters.query: SELECT n.id AS notif_id, n.type, n.title, n.description, n."taskId", t.purpose, t.zones, t."scheduledAt", s.name AS schedule_name, a.name AS agrochemical_name, CASE WHEN a."dosageValue" IS NOT NULL AND a."dosageUnit" IS NOT NULL THEN (a."dosageValue"::text || ' ' || a."dosageUnit"::text) ELSE '' END AS preparation FROM "Notification" n JOIN "TaskLog" t ON n."taskId" = t.id LEFT JOIN "AutomationSchedule" s ON t."scheduleId" = s.id LEFT JOIN "Agrochemical" a ON t."agrochemicalId" = a.id WHERE n.type = 'AGROCHEMICAL_CONFIRM' AND n."readAt" IS NULL ORDER BY n."createdAt" ASC LIMIT 5;
